items.statement: The actual Gibbs mu=volume.tilted(-U) is probability and id belongs to L2(mu). For every direction v, covarianceBilin(mu)(v,v)>=norm(v)^2/beta. This is the linear-observable covariance corollary of Cramer-Rao, not the full nonlinear-observable theorem or a matrix-inverse result.
assumptions: E is a complete finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable space and canonical volume, including dimension zero. alpha,beta are NNReal, 0<alpha<=beta. U or V is genuinely C2; actual Hessian at every point and direction lies between alpha*norm(v)^2 and beta*norm(v)^2.

Every Gibbs law is the actual volume.tilted(-potential). Probability, finite second moments, score integrability, centered score pairing and covariance bounds are derived. No minimizer, finite input moments, partition constant, derivative/score/covariance or well-behaved certificate is supplied.

obligations.label: Cramer-Rao actual covariance lower and source Hessian upper
Higher regularity, stationarity/errors/work and both complete main/composition (remaining)

bindings.boundary: Actual Gibbs all-direction covariance lower bound and its actual RGO/source V_eta Hessian upper consumer only. No Brascamp-Lieb covariance upper/Hessian lower, full Lemma4.1, general nonlinear Cramer-Rao, higher regularity, exact stationarity, approximate/stochastic/history work, PBPS process or either complete main/composition. TV never transfers unbounded expected cost.
